annotations.title: Fetch web pages as clean Markdown with citations

description: Fetches public web pages and returns their main content as clean Markdown (no menus, ads, cookie banners or footers), plus title, author, published/modified dates, language, canonical URL, a heading outline and a ready-made citation. Tables stay Markdown tables; code blocks keep their language. Use it to read, quote or summarise a page or load documentation; cite citation.url. chunk:true returns heading-aware chunks for long pages; mode "sitemap"/"crawl" (with maxPages, includeGlobs like "/docs/**") reads several pages of one site; rendering "auto" only if a page comes back nearly empty. Respects publishers: obeys robots.txt, never bypasses paywalls, logins, CAPTCHAs or bot protection, honours noai/TDM opt-outs — such pages return status "blocked"/"paywalled" with a reason and NO content; do not retry them by other means. Runs an Apify Actor on the caller's own Apify account (billed by Apify pay-per-event, capped per run).

chunk.description: Return heading-aware chunks for long pages (for RAG).

chunkSize.description: Target chunk size in tokens when chunk is true.

contentSelector.description: Optional CSS selector to force the content region.

includeImages.description: Keep image links in the Markdown.

includeLinks.description: Keep hyperlinks in the Markdown (false = fewer tokens).

maxCharsPerPage.description: Server-side truncation of markdown per page; truncatedForAgent=true when cut.

maxDepth.description: How many links deep to follow in crawl mode.

mode.description: "urls" fetches the given pages; "sitemap" or "crawl" reads several pages of one site.

rendering.description: "http" is fastest; use "auto" only if a page comes back nearly empty.

urls.description: Page URLs (or site / sitemap URLs for mode sitemap/crawl).

name: fetch_clean_markdown

dryRun.description: true = built-in SAMPLE data from this server, NOT a real lookup
